# PLAN — iteration 1

## Current state assessment

The incumbent passes simulation and has valid routed metrics, but setup fails at WNS = −0.132 ns; hold passes at WHS = +0.252 ns. The critical path runs from `data1_reg[7]` through the output data mux and OBUF to `out_data[7]`. The objective is LUT reduction, but timing feasibility must come first. The editable top has a known latency of 1, so it must retain `// @latency 1`.

## Hypothesis

Replacing the pointer-selected data banks with a two-entry shift queue will drive `out_data` directly from the head register, removing the output mux and potentially closing setup timing while keeping tail-to-head movement within the available register-to-register margin.

## Instruction for generator

Replace the `skid_buffer_core` instance with inline two-entry FIFO logic using head and tail data registers plus occupancy state; assign `out_data` directly from the head register. On a pop from a full queue, shift the tail into the head; on simultaneous pop and push from a one-entry queue, load the new input into the head, and on simultaneous pop and push from a full queue, shift the tail to the head and load the input into the tail. Preserve the combinational ready rule, valid behavior, synchronous active-high reset priority, transfer timing, stall stability, and `// @latency 1`; data while invalid remains unspecified.
